reconstruction_summary: Reproduced V4 (agent's headline): per-platform linear-ST yaw-rate with fit C_alpha_f=C_alpha_r=350000 N/rad (from out/ladder.json) and per-segment straight-line bias correction, then a ridge(alpha=1.0) residual learner on [v, |a_y|, |delta|, sign(delta_dot)] with leave-one-segment-out CV across all 545 Ford canonical segments.
notes: Agent's V4 was originally fit on 40 Mach-E segments only; C_alpha fit (cf=cr=350000) is Mach-E specific but applied uniformly to both Ford platforms here per the canonical-eval contract. Per-platform geometry/mass/inertia from PARAM_BY_PLATFORM were used in the V3 step. Ridge learner was retrained LOSO across the full canonical set, matching the agent's training procedure on a larger dataset.
